proposed_widenings.name: cylinder shape in Attachment area
proposed_widenings.justification: Reverse Gravity targets a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder. The existing Attachment area shape only supports 'sphere'. Cylinder is a distinct geometric primitive requiring both radius and height parameters.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high Cylinder centered on a point within range."

proposed_widenings.name: force_movement kind in OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's primary mechanic is gravitational reversal — all unanchored creatures in the area are forcibly moved upward. Neither 'roll_modifier' nor 'damage_on_hit' can express this. The v4 atom 'force_move' exists in the taxonomy but no surface-level OngoingOperation variant invokes it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "All creatures and objects in that area that aren't anchored to the ground fall upward and reach the top of the Cylinder."

proposed_widenings.name: resistance_save on area ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The Dex save is a 'save to avoid being pulled' — a creature-initiated resistance against an automatic area effect. This is structurally distinct from ActivationPhase save_gate (which branches damage on forced save). The surface has no 'optional resistance save' pattern on OngoingOperation or Attachment.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall upward."

proposed_widenings.name: on_end consequence in ongoing_effect mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: When the spell ends, affected creatures fall downward — a distinct consequence of the concentration breaking. The v4 atom 'fall_on_end' exists but the surface has no field on OngoingEffectMechanics (or any SpellMechanics) for on-end consequences beyond the duration lifecycle atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall downward."

notes: The spell kind ('spell') and broad family concept ('ongoing_effect' with concentration + area) exist. Four surface-level variants are missing before this unit can be encoded honestly: (1) cylinder area shape, (2) force_movement OngoingOperation, (3) resistance save on area effects, (4) on-end fall consequence. The v4 taxonomy already contains 'force_move' and 'fall_on_end' atoms — the gap is entirely at the surface type level. No Dhall/JSON authored.
